title: Legacy Forever
tagline: LegacyForever Legacy that Stays Forever!  Honor your loved ones by sharing their story, give tribute and keep their memory alive forever which can be easily accessible by future generations.
description: Do we even remember the name of our previous two three generations?If we know the name, is that enough? Do we know the kind of person they were or thestory of their life?Current online platforms provide services to store information about our elders but for how longinformation will stay online? If a website decides to shut down or any failure in servers, will our nexgenerations get a chance to about us?
how_its_made:
Previously we had no such technology which can give us surety that data will store forever and canbe accessed from other planet as well.
We are storing all the data of 1) Biography 2) Family tree 3)Photo Gallery 4) Memories of loved onesin IPFS Web3 storage. Filecoin.
Filecoin plan shows Filecoin nodes through Satellite so that IPFS data can be accessed on otherplanest in the future, isn't it amazing? Even from Mars :) Our next generations will get to knowdetailed info about the legacy we are going to leave.
